fields.description:
## Problem
Gerrit -> GitHub replication stalled during the live P1 object-store outage. CloudWatch alarm rebar-gerrit-mirror-out-of-sync was ALARM and Mirror Guard repeatedly reported GitHub tip static across 3 samples. Gerrit main was 12acd6e18be760e9df83f049957dacf9983e8ff3 while GitHub main was stuck at 665d1d0480187380f82e59bd95af1f0c44274732.

## Investigation plan
- Read Gerrit replication_log around the stall start (~2026-09-08 03:37 PDT / 10:37 UTC).
- Test suspects one at a time: rotated replication deploy key not loaded/reloaded; replication queue wedged by missing-object failures; fallout from mirror-fetch recovery.
- Confirm whether refs/heads/main replication is configured and whether tickets branch is excluded or independently managed.
- Fix the confirmed cause with minimal operational change. If code/infra source changes are needed, land them through Gerrit.
- Trigger full replication using the Gerrit replication plugin command and wait for completion.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] replication_log evidence identifies the first failing mode at the stall start.
- [x] The confirmed root cause is documented on this ticket.
- [x] Gerrit -> GitHub replication is repaired without touching Gerrit git data before snapshot when mutation is needed.
- [x] Full replication is triggered and completes or reports explicit per-ref errors.
- [x] GitHub main equals Gerrit main after repair.
- [x] Mirror Guard is green on its next run, or any remaining alarm lag is explained with timestamps.
- [x] Confirm whether the replication config includes refs/heads/tickets or only code refs.

## Resolution
Restarted only the Gerrit container at 2026-09-08T14:03Z to reload the already-materialized rotated GitHub replication key, then ran `replication start --all --remote github --now --wait`. GitHub main caught up to Gerrit main, Mirror Guard run 34236004089 passed, and CloudWatch returned OK at 2026-09-08T14:06:59Z.

Root cause: the key rotation materialized the new private key on disk and verified one replication before retiring the old GitHub deploy key, but the running Gerrit/JGit replication plugin kept using a cached SSH session/key with old fingerprint SHA256:jBCGL6vjKQfNJQjW9qs43uVpUp7Nfo/2Ygx3kgN7Rmk. After the old deploy key was removed from GitHub, replication failed continuously with publickey auth errors until Gerrit restart reloaded key material.

Prevention landed in Gerrit change 2841: setup-replication now documents restart/reload before verification and old-key retirement, with regression tests pinning the order.

## Constraints
Never use --force. Do not restart Gerrit or mutate Gerrit git data unless coordinated through the object-store incident. Snapshot before any repository repair. Keep downtime minimal.
